title: Gut microbiome diversity and sleep quality
authors: First Author, Second Author, Third Author

sections.heading: Background
sections.body:
• Sleep disorders are increasingly common
• The gut-brain axis may regulate sleep
• Evidence in humans is limited

sections.heading: Methods
sections.body:
• 200 adult volunteers
• Stool 16S rRNA sequencing
• Two-week sleep diaries

sections.heading: Results
sections.body:
• Lower diversity in the poor-sleep group
• Several genera correlate with sleep scores

sections.heading: Conclusions
sections.body:
• Diversity may be a marker of sleep quality
• Causality needs intervention studies
